name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Kannada
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-12): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Kannada files have 'Dakshina Dataset' rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops (the project's licence audit keeps them out of a pack): 51,117 Dakshina rows are dropped by the filter. There are no 'Existing sources' rows. What is used is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: kan_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/kn.neopack. Kannada has manual rows only in kan_test.json, so the romanised Kannada tables (data/langs/kn/romanisation.json) are fitted to the mined IndicCorp rows of kan_valid.json (3,271 pairs after the filter), which also validate training. kan_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-12. Extract with: unzip kan.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-kan/extracted (data/build-kn-text.sh does). kan_train.json has 2,906,728 rows: IndicCorp 2,826,695, Dakshina 43,373, Samanantar 36,482, Wikidata 178 (no manual rows). kan_valid.json 7,025: IndicCorp 3,849, Dakshina 2,729, Samanantar 441, Wikidata 6 (no manual rows). kan_test.json 11,380: Dakshina 5,015, AK-Freq 4,213, AK-NEI 1,274, AK-NEF 878. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/kn.neopack, a beta download on the site (credited in its manifest), not in the app
